title: Codebase Architecture & Structure
scope: Map the overall layout, entry points, build system, and module organization of the kimi-cli repository.

entry_points.name: kimi-code
entry_points.target: packages/kimi-code -> re-exports kimi_cli via sys.modules alias

release_tooling: tag-prefix (pure-numeric tags for kimi-cli; kosong- / pykaos- prefixed tags)

module_registry.purpose: Typer CLI entrypoint & lazy subcommand group registry
LLM provider abstraction/proxy layer (delegates to kosong)
Agent tool registry (shell, file, web, agent, etc.)
FastAPI web UI backend + store + runner
Compatibility alias package re-exporting kimi_cli (PyPI: kimi-code)
Python SDK for the Kimi API (PyPI: kimi-sdk)
CI/release/dev helper scripts (build, version check, sha injection)
Design proposal docs (KLIP) for repo architecture decisions

findings.monorepo_layout: uv workspace at repo root: root package `kimi-cli` (v1.49.0) lives at `src/kimi_cli/` and is the main Typer CLI agent; `packages/kosong` (LLM abstraction), `packages/kaos` (pykaos runtime), `packages/kimi-code` (kimi_cli alias), and `sdks/kimi-sdk` are workspace members with independent pyproject.toml + PyPI identities. TypeScript frontends `web/` (Vite+React+TS web UI) and `vis/` (Vite+React+TS tracing visualizer) are built via `scripts/build_web.py` & `scripts/build_vis.py` and baked into kimi_cli.web/vis assets via PyInstaller `kimi.spec`. Tag-based releases split per package (numeric tag triggers kimi-cli release; kosong- / pykaos- prefixes trigger respective PyPI publishes); kosong docs URL preserved by pushing gh-pages to the legacy MoonshotAI/kosong repo. The `deps/` dir (ripgrep binary vendored) is excluded from builds via source-exclude.

proposal: ai-factory could emulate kimi-cli's plugin/module discovery pattern using a pydantic-settings-based settings model that scans a registry directory at startup and dynamically imports each subpackage, validating each tool/plugin entrypoint against a strict pydantic `ToolSpec` model (name, command, schema, category, dependencies) loaded from per-module `pyi`-style metadata. Combining pydantic-settings for env-driven config with importlib entry-point or directory scanning mirrors kimi-cli's layered skills discovery (builtin -> user -> project) while keeping ai-factory's fail-fast/validated philosophy; a single `uv.lock`-style lockfile for the orchestrator's own dev tooling would further align ai-factory's build determinism with kimi-cli's multi-package uv workspace approach.

pydantic_ai_2_impl.why_now: ai-factory tier agents emit schema-valid but hallucinated output (a tool call / file path / command that does not exist), which passes Agent(retries=5) pydantic schema checks then detonates downstream verification — the raw 'LLM said it did X but nothing changed' failure. Ground-truth probing the output boundary at the model turns silent, deferred verification failures into deterministic, retried rejections so hallucination dies inline instead of cascading across phases.
pydantic_ai_2_impl.harness_gap: output_sanitizer.py only repairs structurally-broken JSON offline; nothing validates that the LLM's structured claims match ground truth (PATH existence, file existence, tool-registry membership) at the model-output boundary, so false-but-well-formed output propagates unchecked and surfaces as late verification failures.
